== Japanese printed face ==
Full collector photograph visually transcribed and compared with the English printed face. The Japanese target condition says a droid that is “not there”; the English explicitly says “not on Death Star.” The Japanese uses location card where the English specifies site, and names R2 in the lore where the English says “he.” Publication ID 1301_46o follows the approved Japanese catalog; this is not a GEMP implementation claim. Source preservation remains pending.
